import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long N = 2002002;
    static long[] a = new long[(int) N];

    static long solve(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long j = 1, cnt = 1;
        while (j <= n) {
            j = (j * 10) + 1;
            cnt++;
        }
        cnt--;
        j = (j - 1) / 10;
        if (j == n) return cnt;
        long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        if (j * 10 + 1 - n < n) {
            long temp = solve(j * 10 + 1 - n) + cnt + 1;
            if (temp < best) best = temp;
        }
        long best2 = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long i = 1;
        while (j * i <= n) {
            best2 = j * i;
            i++;
        }
        long option1 = solve(n - best2) + cnt * (i - 1);
        return Math.min(option1, best);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(solve(n));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
